generations.name: First generation (60 kWh)
generations.notes: Launch hatchback on GM's BEV2 platform: 60 kWh LG Chem NMC pack, optional CCS DC fast charging (about 55 kW peak), 7.2 kW onboard AC. EPA range 238 mi. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Bolt ; https://insideevs.com/news/366750/2020-chevrolet-bolt-ev-259-miles-range/

generations.name: 2020 battery update (65-66 kWh)
generations.notes: For 2020 GM changed the cell chemistry: 66 kWh gross (later quoted as 65 kWh), EPA range 259 mi; same charging hardware (about 55 kW DC). The 2022 refresh (new body and interior, shared with the Bolt EUV launch) kept this pack and charger, so 2020-2023 is one charging generation. Production ended December 2023. Note the 2017-2022 cars got LG replacement packs under the 2021 battery recall (powertrain-level detail, not a generation). Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/366750/2020-chevrolet-bolt-ev-259-miles-range/ ; https://www.autoblog.com/news/2020-chevrolet-bolt-first-drive ; https://insideevs.com/news/490154/technical-comparison-new-chevrolet-bolt-ev-euv/
